events.question: How many customers churned in Q3 2026?

intent.status: Found subscriptions and organizations for churn analysis

events.label: Found subscriptions and organizations for churn analysis

plan.headline: Counts customers whose paid subscription ended with a churn reason in Q3 2026, excluding upgrades and downgrades.

metrics.title: Churned customers
metrics.description: Number of distinct organizations with a subscription canceled for reason 'churn' in the selected period, with no other active or trialing subscription at the end of the period (so plan changes are not counted).

metrics.title: Churned customers by week
metrics.description: Weekly count of distinct organizations whose subscription was canceled for churn during the selected period, bucketed in the chosen timezone.

metrics.title: Churned customers by plan tier
metrics.description: Distinct churned organizations in the selected period, grouped by the plan tier of the canceled subscription. Subscriptions with no plan are shown as unknown.

assumptions.label: Period
assumptions.rationale: Q3 2026 runs July 1 through September 30, as asked.

assumptions.label: Timezone
assumptions.rationale: Cancellation dates are assigned to calendar days in UTC unless you prefer your business timezone.

assumptions.label: Exclude test orgs
assumptions.rationale: The data dictionary says test, demo and load-test tenants should be excluded from business metrics.

assumptions.label: Churn reason only
assumptions.rationale: Plan changes close the old subscription row with reason upgrade or downgrade, so only cancel_reason = 'churn' counts as a lost customer.

events.sql:
WITH canceled AS (
  SELECT s.org_id, s.canceled_at
  FROM northwind.subscriptions s
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id
  WHERE s.canceled_at IS NOT NULL
    AND s.canceled_at >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text
    AND s.canceled_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text
    AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)
    AND (NOT :churn_reason_only::boolean OR s.cancel_reason = 'churn')
),
canceled_orgs AS (
  SELECT org_id, max(canceled_at) AS last_canceled_at FROM canceled GROUP BY org_id
),
prev_canceled AS (
  SELECT s.org_id
  FROM northwind.subscriptions s
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id
  WHERE s.canceled_at IS NOT NULL
    AND s.canceled_at >= (:date_range_prev_start::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text
    AND s.canceled_at < (:date_range_prev_end::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text
    AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)
    AND (NOT :churn_reason_only::boolean OR s.cancel_reason = 'churn')
  GROUP BY s.org_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM canceled_orgs c
   WHERE NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM northwind.subscriptions s2
     WHERE s2.org_id = c.org_id
       AND s2.status IN ('active','trialing','past_due')
       AND s2.canceled_at IS NULL
       AND s2.started_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text
   )) AS value,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM prev_canceled p
   WHERE NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM northwind.subscriptions s2
     WHERE s2.org_id = p.org_id
       AND s2.status IN ('active','trialing','past_due')
       AND s2.canceled_at IS NULL
       AND s2.started_at < (:date_range_prev_end::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text
   )) AS previous_value
events.explanation: Counts distinct orgs with a subscription canceled (reason 'churn' when enabled) in the period, excluding orgs that still hold a live subscription started before period end, with prior-period comparison.

events.sql:
WITH churned AS (
  SELECT s.org_id, s.id AS sub_id, s.canceled_at, COALESCE(p.tier, 'unknown') AS tier
  FROM northwind.subscriptions s
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id
  LEFT JOIN northwind.plans p ON p.id = s.plan_id
  WHERE s.canceled_at IS NOT NULL
    AND s.canceled_at >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text
    AND s.canceled_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text
    AND (NOT :churn_reason_only::boolean OR s.cancel_reason = 'churn')
    AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)
    -- exclude orgs that still hold another live subscription at period end (plan changes)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM northwind.subscriptions s2
      WHERE s2.org_id = s.org_id
        AND s2.id <> s.id
        AND s2.status IN ('active','trialing')
        AND s2.started_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text
        AND (s2.canceled_at IS NULL OR s2.canceled_at >= (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text)
    )
),
-- one tier per org: the latest canceled subscription in the period
per_org AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (org_id) org_id, tier
  FROM churned
  ORDER BY org_id, canceled_at DESC, sub_id DESC
)
SELECT tier AS label, count(*)::int AS value
FROM per_org
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY value DESC, label
LIMIT 20
events.explanation: Counts distinct orgs with a churn-reason cancellation in the period and no other live subscription at period end, assigned to the tier of their latest canceled subscription (unknown if no plan).

WITH churned AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.org_id,
         date_trunc('week', s.canceled_at AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text)::date AS week_start
  FROM northwind.subscriptions s
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id
  WHERE s.canceled_at IS NOT NULL
    AND s.canceled_at >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
    AND s.canceled_at <  (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
    AND (NOT :churn_reason_only::boolean OR s.cancel_reason = 'churn')
    AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)
    -- plan changes: skip orgs that still have a live subscription at period end
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM northwind.subscriptions s2
      WHERE s2.org_id = s.org_id
        AND s2.id <> s.id
        AND s2.started_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
        AND (s2.canceled_at IS NULL OR s2.canceled_at >= (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text)
    )
)
SELECT week_start AS x, count(*)::int AS y
FROM churned
GROUP BY week_start
ORDER BY week_start
events.explanation: Counts distinct organizations per week (in the chosen timezone) whose subscription was canceled for churn within the period, excluding test orgs and orgs that still have another live subscription at period end.

review.summary: The churned-by-tier breakdown is broadly right, but the check for whether an org still has a live subscription uses today's status instead of the status at the end of Q3, so a few plan-change orgs may be miscounted as churned.

issues.message: In the NOT EXISTS subquery, replace s2.status IN ('active','trialing') with a point-in-time test on started_at/canceled_at; status is today's value, so a sub live on 2026-10-01 but canceled later counts as not live.
The s2.status filter also skips 'past_due' subscriptions, which are still live, so orgs moved to a past_due replacement plan are counted as churned.

review.summary: The count is roughly right, but the check for whether a churned customer still had another live subscription uses today's status instead of the state at the end of each period, so some plan-change orgs may be miscounted as churned.

issues.message: The NOT EXISTS check filters s2.status IN (...) AND s2.canceled_at IS NULL, which reflects today's status. Orgs whose other subscription was live at period end but canceled later get counted as churned. Test as of the period end instead: started_at < end AND (canceled_at IS NULL OR canceled_at >= end).
previous_value has the same current-status problem, and it is worse there: anything canceled between 2026-07-01 and today is ignored when testing for a live subscription at :date_range_prev_end.

review.summary: The churn logic, timezone handling, test exclusion and Q3 boundaries are correct, but weeks with no churn are left out of the line and an org can be counted in more than one week, so I fixed both.

issues.message: Weeks with zero churned orgs produce no row, so the line chart skips or interpolates them; generate the full set of weeks with generate_series and LEFT JOIN the churn counts onto it.

SELECT DISTINCT s.org_id, week_start counts an org once per week, so an org with two churn cancellations in different weeks is counted twice; assign each org to its first churn week with min() GROUP BY s.org_id so the weeks add up to the KPI.

review.rewritten_sql:
WITH churned AS (
  SELECT s.org_id,
         min(date_trunc('week', s.canceled_at AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text))::date AS week_start
  FROM northwind.subscriptions s
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id
  WHERE s.canceled_at IS NOT NULL
    AND s.canceled_at >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
    AND s.canceled_at <  (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
    AND (NOT :churn_reason_only::boolean OR s.cancel_reason = 'churn')
    AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM northwind.subscriptions s2
      WHERE s2.org_id = s.org_id
        AND s2.id <> s.id
        AND s2.started_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
        AND (s2.canceled_at IS NULL OR s2.canceled_at >= (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text)
    )
  GROUP BY s.org_id
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
           date_trunc('week', (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp),
           ((:date_range_end::date) - 1)::timestamp,
           interval '1 week'
         )::date AS week_start
)
SELECT w.week_start AS x, count(c.org_id)::int AS y
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN churned c ON c.week_start = w.week_start
GROUP BY w.week_start
ORDER BY w.week_start
